{{Quote|Our signature menu item served fresh off the grill! We start with a perfectly seasoned, hand-formed, 100 percent pure Mongo Beefhead patty&mdash;no additives or Gank fillers here&mdash;served on the finest trans&mdash;shipped, medium density food-board available.|Dex's Diner menu on the Mongo Beefhead patty|<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Mongo Beefhead patties''' were served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] operated by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|cook]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Menu" /> The patties shared their name with the [[Mongo Beefhead]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Tales of Phantom Toys">{{GalaxyCite|2|Galactic Bazaar|Galactic Bazaar: Tales of Phantom Toys}}</ref> The patties were seasoned, [[Limb/Legends|hand]]-formed, and had no present additives or [[Gank fillers]]. They were served on trans-shipped, medium-density [[Foodboard|food-boards]] and were used in several of the [[slider]]s in the diner, which included the [[Coruscant slider]], [[Giju slider]], [[Khomm slider]], [[Socorro slider]], [[Talus and Tralus slider]], and the [[Zeltros slider]]s. The patties were served at the diner<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I have a fondness for abandoned concepts, hence the inclusion of the donut droid as well as references to Revwiens, Adarians, apple slugs and even Kenner's Mongo Beefhead Tribesman.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}.</ref>}}
Mongo Beefhead patties were first mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article written by [[Gregory Walker]]. The article was formatted as an in-universe menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="Menu" /> Walker's fondness for unused concepts led to the patties being named after<ref name="Blog" /> the Mongo Beefhead species, which first appeared in the canceled [[The Epic Continues]] toy line from the toy company [[Kenner Products|Kenner]].<ref name="Tales of Phantom Toys" />
